testCases.title: Verify Accessibility of Contact Form
expectedResults: The contact form is accessible on the contact page.

testCases.title: Verify Required Fields in Contact Form
steps: Navigate to the contact page and open the contact form.
expectedResults: All required fields are displayed in the contact form.

testCases.title: Verify Subject Dropdown Options
steps: Open the subject dropdown in the contact form.
expectedResults: The subject dropdown contains all specified options.

testCases.title: Verify Validation for Message Length
steps: Enter a message with less than 50 characters in the message field.
expectedResults: A validation error is shown indicating the message must be at least 50 characters.

testCases.title: Verify Confirmation Message upon Successful Submission
steps: Fill in all required fields in the contact form with valid data.
expectedResults: A confirmation message is displayed upon successful form submission.
